description: This file defines a Java class 'CreateJournalEntryCommandHandler' that handles the creation of journal entries in the accounting module of the Fineract system. It implements a command handler interface, uses dependency injection for the service layer, and processes create commands transactionally.

classes.name: CreateJournalEntryCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the creation of journal entries; implements the command handler interface and is annotated as a Spring service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to create a journal entry by delegating to the writePlatformService within a transactional context.
